title: 评分怎么算：四级阶梯、字母等级与加权
summary: 回复按披露、认知、管理、领导力四级评估；最终给 D- 到 A 的字母分，阈值与 essential criteria 共同决定进阶。
sourceNote: 本页按 CDP 官方文件整理；悬浮「原文」可查看对应官方原文。正式评分请以 CDP 当期评分介绍为准。

steps.title: Disclosure 披露
steps.desc: 开始披露环境影响，完整性不足

steps.title: Awareness 认知
steps.desc: 理解环境议题与业务的关联

steps.title: Management 管理
steps.desc: 有管理环境影响的行动与流程

steps.title: Leadership 领导力
steps.desc: 最佳实践的透明度与绩效

blocks.content_cn: 企业沿披露、认知、管理、领导力四级递进，体现迈向环境管理的过程。

quote.text: Responding organizations are assessed and scored across four consecutive levels which represent the steps an organization moves through as it progresses towards environmental stewardship. These four levels are Disclosure, Awareness, Management and Leadership.

sections.title: 字母等级 D- 到 A

blocks.content_cn: 每个议题按得分百分比给出从 A 到 D- 的最终字母评分，层内再分两档。

quote.text: Responders are allocated a final letter score for each environmental issue area on which they have been scored, ranging from A to D-.

sections.title: 阈值与 essential criteria 进阶

blocks.content_cn: 须在某一层达到最低分才能进入上一层；即便越过阈值，未满足该层 essential criteria 也不能获评该层。

quote.text: As well as achieving a minimum score in a level to be able to move to the next level, CDP also utilizes a system of essential criteria. To be able to achieve a score within a given score level, these criteria must be met within the response.

cards.content: 气候的 essential criteria 横跨四层；森林与水安全仅用于领导力与 A 名单层。

quote.text: Essential criteria are present for Climate Change across Awareness, Management, Leadership and A list.

sections.title: 加权计算（管理与领导力层）

cards.title: 比例评分
cards.content: 按披露信息量比例给分，激励完整填报。

cards.title: 最优行评分
cards.content: 仅取得分最高的一行参与计分。

cards.title: 整合评分
cards.content: 多议题数据按行分别计分，避免重复。
披露与认知层用简单百分比；管理与领导力层用类别权重计算百分比。

quote.text: For Management and Leadership scoring levels, a weighted percentage is calculated.

cards.content: CDP 评分基于回复中披露的活动与立场，并非可持续性的综合度量或“绿色”指标。

quote.text: The CDP score is based on activities and positions disclosed in the CDP response. The score is not a comprehensive metric of an organization’s level of sustainability or ‘green-ness’, or a specific metric on the environmental footprint, but rather an indication of the level of action taken by the organization to assess and manage its impacts on, and from, environmental related issues during the reporting year.

cards.content: CDP 与其评分伙伴均不核证单个企业回复中的信息，仅依据回复内容评分。

quote.text: Neither CDP nor CDP’s scoring partners verify the information in any individual organization’s response.
